notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
You control an additional modified creature with power one or greater.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering One with the Kami, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Each Spirit enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Repeat.
